AfterQuery builds the expert evaluation data that frontier AI labs use to measure and improve their models. We're hiring special education teachers as contractors to author and grade the IEP and intervention scenarios those evaluations run on.

What you'll actually do

  • Grade model output for compliance and appropriateness for the student

Who this is for

  • Special education certification or license, or an equivalent credential
  • 2+ years of teaching in special education settings
  • Depth in IEP development, accommodations, and differentiated instruction
